title: GET /config/v2/taxRates answers an array of TaxRate objects; the default PERCENT rate carries its decimal rate

source.note: The operation 'Returns an array of TaxRate objects' (at most 300 per page) and requires Toast-Restaurant-External-ID, 'The Toast POS GUID of the restaurant that the configuration applies to'. TaxRate: guid 'The GUID maintained by the Toast POS', entityType 'The type of object this is', name, isDefault 'True if this tax rate is the default tax rate', rate 'For a percent tax rate, the percentage is expressed as a decimal value. For example, if the tax rate is 6.25%, then rate is 0.0625', type enum PERCENT|FIXED|TABLE|NONE|EXTERNAL, roundingType 'Only applies to PERCENT tax rates', taxTable and conditionalTaxRates arrays. The seed carries exactly the documented 6.25% example as its one, default rate; the list length is the seed's.
